description.narrative: The objectives of the assignment are to provide: (a) engineering designs for the power station building extensions; (b) coordination of building designs with the engine foundation designs by the Turnkey Contractor (TC); (c) final approvals of designs produced by the TC; (d) on-site monitoring and performance review of engineering and procurement contracts, and construction activities; (e) services for the certification of sources of procurement; and, (f) construction progress reporting to ANGLEC and CDB, and engineering liaison services between the ANGLEC and the TC

This project is designed to improve the capacity and operational capability of Anguilla Electricity Company Limited (ANGLEC) through the addition of generating capacity and an extension to the existing power station
